name: 48864 · Okemos, MI
findings: ZIP 48864 (Okemos) has 210 nonprofit organizations. 105 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48864 (Okemos) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
